<congress display="no">119th CONGRESS</congress><session display="no">1st Session</session><legis-num display="no">H.R. 4</legis-num><current-chamber display="yes">In the Senate of the United States,</current-chamber><action><action-date date="20250717" legis-day="20250716">July 17 (legislative day, July 16), 2025.</action-date></action><legis-type display="yes">Amendment:</legis-type></engrossed-amendment-form><engrossed-amendment-body><section id="id9027fcbcea614ab7a1c77d24240d8677" section-type="resolved"><text>That the bill from the House of Representatives (H.R. 4) entitled <quote>An Act to rescind certain budget authority proposed to be rescinded in special messages transmitted to the Congress by the President on June 3, 2025, in accordance with section 1012(a) of the Congressional Budget and Impoundment Control Act of 1974.</quote>, do pass with the following</text></section><amendment><amendment-instruction blank-lines-after="0"><text> Strike all after the enacting clause and insert the following: </text></amendment-instruction><amendment-block blank-lines-after="1" changed="added" reported-display-style="italic"><section section-type="section-one" id="H0DB62F6D0C13474589D2F4C2B87BBF40"><enum>1.</enum><header>Short Title</header><text display-inline="no-display-inline">This Act may be cited as the <quote><short-title>Rescissions Act of 2025</short-title></quote>.</text></section><section id="HE064C52D697245E5991DECE8EACCFE37"><enum>2.</enum><header>Rescissions of budget authority</header><subsection id="H75007576265F4EC29BE330CB36B765AC"><enum>(a)</enum><header>In general</header><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Pursuant to the special message transmitted by the President on June 3, 2025, to the House of Representatives and the Senate proposing the rescission of budget authority under section 1012 of part B of title X of the Congressional Budget and Impoundment Control Act of 1974 (<external-xref legal-doc="usc" parsable-cite="usc/2/682">2 U.S.C. 682 et seq.</external-xref>), the rescissions described under subsection (b) shall take effect immediately upon the date of enactment of this Act.</text></subsection><subsection id="H791EFE42C2D44649A0EC3BEF3BB93816"><enum>(b)</enum><header>Rescissions</header><text>The rescissions described in this subsection are as follows:</text><paragraph id="H34DFEAED976E4241AC6A7E8E2A92A3A3"><enum>(1)</enum><text>Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>International Organizations—Contributions to International Organizations</quote> made available by the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2024 (division F of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/118/47">Public Law 118–47</external-xref>), $33,008,764 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HF1EB45BE3F47453BA4D400FFA6575D5A"><enum>(2)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>International Organizations—Contributions to International Organizations</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $168,837,230 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HF53AA2B5003C4DDC8CC8FC972E5AA8E1"><enum>(3)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>International Organizations—Contributions for International Peacekeeping Activities</quote> made available by the Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act, 2024 (division F of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/118/47">Public Law 118–47</external-xref>), $203,328,007 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H6F8EE398503B45E0AD62C867ED75BEDF"><enum>(4)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>International Organizations—Contributions for International Peacekeeping Activities</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $157,906,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H2C87A8B88A6B4C9592F3B21C1A781FF7"><enum>(5)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances in the first paragraph under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Funds Appropriated to the President—Global Health Programs</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $500,000,000 are rescinded: <proviso><italic>Provided,</italic></proviso> That none of the amounts rescinded under this paragraph shall be from the unobligated balances for the following programs: HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis, Malaria, Nutrition, or Maternal and Child Health: <proviso><italic>Provided further,</italic></proviso> That the preceding proviso does not apply to family planning and reproductive health programs.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H71170F44D20F4A7CBBE4CF8355BE270A"><enum>(6)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Department of State—Migration and Refugee Assistance</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $800,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H14D7874734AC424E94223666178ED0D3"><enum>(7)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Funds Appropriated to the President—Complex Crises Fund</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $43,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H4709CA5210C74415A83259D945580743"><enum>(8)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Funds Appropriated to the President—Democracy Fund</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $83,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HAE4CD57042084A0B9149CE364A42319A"><enum>(9)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Funds Appropriated to the President—Economic Support Fund</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $1,650,000,000 are rescinded: <proviso><italic>Provided,</italic></proviso> That none of the funds rescinded under this paragraph shall be from the unobligated balances for assistance to Jordan, Egypt, or the Countering PRC Influence Fund.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HB792850487AB442DA37301767E514695"><enum>(10)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Multilateral Assistance—International Financial Institutions—Contribution to the Clean Technology Fund</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $125,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H1AA150CA0F0B44CFAC35D1DA5668D3AA"><enum>(11)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Multilateral Assistance—Funds Appropriated to the President—International Organizations and Programs</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $436,920,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HF86DF280EED74FDC9C687165214EDA02"><enum>(12)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Funds Appropriated to the President—Development Assistance</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $2,500,000,000 are rescinded: <proviso><italic>Provided,</italic></proviso> That none of the funds rescinded under this paragraph shall be from the unobligated balances for Feed the Future Innovation Labs or the Countering PRC Influence Fund: <proviso><italic>Provided further,</italic></proviso> That none of the funds rescinded under this paragraph shall affect the administration of United States commodity-based food aid, including the Food for Peace program and the McGovern-Dole International Food for Education and Child Nutrition Program.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H0F8645FDE12A4DD0B4B918E42CC5F86F"><enum>(13)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Funds Appropriated to the President—Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $460,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H3B2B6FCA71F94655B82A3E008E8B18A3" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(14)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Funds Appropriated to the President—International Disaster Assistance</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $496,000,000 are rescinded: <proviso><italic>Provided,</italic></proviso> That none of the funds rescinded shall affect the administration of United States commodity-based food aid, including the Food for Peace program and the McGovern-Dole International Food for Education and Child Nutrition Program.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HF2A56802E33D4DA3BAFC249B2088F0BF"><enum>(15)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>United States Agency for International Development—Funds Appropriated to the President—Operating Expenses</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $125,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H6594E04733F848F5BD14F4C98807D951"><enum>(16)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Funds Appropriated to the President—Transition Initiatives</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $57,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H3A7E718A682249E9ABDB7F1621DFAE98"><enum>(17)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Independent Agencies—Inter-American Foundation</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $27,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H94AD7C913C57441ABD8CC2DC7D66AD88" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(18)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Bilateral Economic Assistance—Independent Agencies—United States African Development Foundation</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $22,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="HF3A50EC4D23F4BCEA853DC1FFFA26D03"><enum>(19)</enum><text display-inline="yes-display-inline">Of the unobligated balances under the heading <quote>Related Programs—United States Institute of Peace</quote> made available by the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025 (division A of <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref>), $15,000,000 are rescinded.</text></paragraph><paragraph id="H5B0D8F26EDCA49D7BA38E047B9FC9EF2"><enum>(20)</enum><subparagraph commented="no" display-inline="yes-display-inline" id="H0F1C287F80D0481D8D3852912C6D6CA5"><enum>(A)</enum><text>Amounts made available for <quote>Corporation for Public Broadcasting</quote> for fiscal year 2026 by <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/118/47">Public Law 118–47</external-xref> are rescinded.</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="HFE9F6B76AC98440D8409E615569AC1E7" indent="up1" commented="no" display-inline="no-display-inline"><enum>(B)</enum><text>Amounts made available for <quote>Corporation for Public Broadcasting</quote> for fiscal year 2027 by <external-xref legal-doc="public-law" parsable-cite="pl/119/4">Public Law 119–4</external-xref> are rescinded.</text></subparagraph></paragraph></subsection></section></amendment-block></amendment></engrossed-amendment-body><attestation><attestation-group><attestor></attestor><role>Secretary</role></attestation-group></attestation><endorsement></endorsement></amendment-doc>
